sources.title: Presidential Decree No. 872 of 1 December 2025: temporary entry arrangements for Chinese citizens
sources.publisher: President of the Russian Federation, reproduced by the MFA Consular Department
sources.officialityEvidence: The Russian MFA Consular Department reproduces the original decree and links it from its China bilateral legal register. Paragraphs 1-3 establish ordinary PRC passports, permitted visits, 30-day stays and excluded purposes. Its original deadline must be read with Decree 499, not treated as the current expiry.
sources.supportingExcerpt: без оформления виз на основании обычного паспорта гражданина Китайской Народной Республики.

sources.title: Presidential Decree No. 499 of 20 July 2026: extension of Decree 872
sources.publisher: President of the Russian Federation, reproduced by the MFA Consular Department
sources.officialityEvidence: One-page signed decree, linked by the destination MFA's China bilateral legal register. The PDF was opened and its rendered page inspected. Paragraph 1 replaces the inclusive 14 September 2026 end date with 31 December 2027; paragraph 2 makes the amendment effective on signature, dated 20 July 2026.

policies.title: Chinese ordinary passports: Russian visa waiver extended through 2027
policies.summary: Decree 499 extends the ordinary Chinese passport waiver under Decree 872 through 31 December 2027 inclusive; qualifying visits remain limited to 30 days.
conditions: For an ordinary PRC passport and private, business or tourist visits, the listed scientific, cultural, public-political, economic or sporting events, or transit.
The decree excludes employment, including journalism, education, residence, and the specified international road-transport drivers, crew, freight forwarders and accompanying interpreters.
Russian law continues to govern the visitor's stay. This policy does not establish admission on Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, diplomatic, service or other special documents.

The amendment takes effect on 20 July 2026; this is an extension date, not the original waiver's start date. The MFA summary's older deadline is superseded by Decree 499. Recheck arrangements after 31 December 2027.
